title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor Customer Service Representative Customer Support Advisor Contact Centre Advisor

Crewe, Cheshire Full-Time 40 Hours per Week 7-Day Rota Variable Shifts

Introduction

Acorn by Synergie is recruiting for Customer Service Advisors to join a growing team in Crewe, Cheshire.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in customer service, contact centres, retail, hospitality or another service-focused environment who enjoys helping people and finding solutions.

You'll handle customer enquiries, understand their needs and take ownership of issues through to resolution, while working as part of a supportive and collaborative team.

If you're a confident communicator who can stay calm under pressure and genuinely enjoys making a difference to customers, we'd like to hear from you.

What We Offer
- Full-time position, 40 hours per week.
- 7-day rota with variable start and finish times.
- Free onsite parking.
- Free access to onsite gym facilities.
- Access to the Acorn by Synergie Worker Wellbeing Programme.
- Acorn by Synergie rewards, discounts and offers scheme.
- Supportive, friendly and inclusive working environment.
- Opportunity to develop your customer service skills within a growing team.

Key Duties
- Handle inbound customer enquiries professionally and with empathy.
- Listen to customers, understand their needs and identify appropriate solutions.
- Take ownership of customer issues and work towards the best possible outcome.
- Provide clear and accurate information using a range of internal systems.
- Resolve queries efficiently while maintaining high customer service standards.
- Work closely with specialist teams when additional support is required.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records.
- Handle customer information responsibly and maintain high standards of data security.
- Contribute positively to a team environment focused on collaboration and customer satisfaction.

Requirements
- Previous experience in customer service, contact centre, retail, hospitality or another service-based role.
- Excellent verbal communication and active listening skills.
- Positive, professional and customer-focused approach.
- Confident using computers and able to learn new systems quickly.
- Ability to remain calm, organised and professional in a busy environment.
- Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to take ownership of customer queries.
- Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
- Flexible approach to working hours and shift patterns.

Working Hours

The role involves working 40 hours per week across a 7-day rota, with variable start and finish times within the following core opening hours:
- Monday-Friday: 8am-8pm
- Saturday: 9am-6pm
- Sunday: 10am-5pm

You will be required to work one weekend day for two out of every three weekends, with the third weekend fully off.

Interested?

title: Service Advisor
description:
SERVICE ADVISOR
Location: Crewe
Salary: Basic salary & OTE £34,500
Hours: Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:30pm, 1 in 3 Saturdays 8:30am-12:00pm
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

LOOKING FOR YOUR NEXT SERVICE ADVISOR ROLE?
Are you an experienced Service Advisor looking for your next opportunity within a busy automotive dealership?
We're looking for a motivated and customer-focused Service Advisor to join an established automotive business in Crewe. As a Service Advisor, you'll be the key link between customers and the workshop, ensuring every vehicle booking, service, repair and customer interaction is managed professionally from initial booking through to vehicle collection.
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
£34,500 OTE
Performance-related bonus and productivity incentives
Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:30pm
1 in 3 Saturday mornings, 8:30am-12:00pm
Full-time, permanent position
28 days annual leave including bank holidays
Manufacturer training and career development
Employee vehicle purchase and servicing discounts
Friendly and supportive working environment
Genuine opportunity to develop your automotive career

THE ROLE
As a Service Advisor, you'll be responsible for delivering a professional and customer-focused aftersales experience while ensuring workshop operations run smoothly.
Working closely with customers, technicians and the wider aftersales team, the Service Advisor will manage vehicles throughout the service and repair process, keeping customers informed and ensuring work is completed efficiently and to a high standard.
Your responsibilities will include:
Welcoming customers and providing a professional and friendly service
Booking vehicles in for servicing, maintenance and repairs
Managing customer appointments and workshop bookings
Keeping customers updated throughout the service and repair process
Preparing accurate estimates and explaining repair recommendations to customers
Discussing additional work and recommending relevant products and services
Maximising opportunities for additional sales where appropriate
Handling customer queries and resolving issues professionally
Managing customer expectations regarding costs and completion times
Preparing job cards and ensuring accurate vehicle information is recorded
Ensuring all paperwork and computer records are completed accurately
Maintaining excellent levels of customer satisfaction
Working closely with the Workshop Controller and Service Manager
Following manufacturer and company procedures
Supporting the wider Aftersales team when required

ABOUT YOU
We're looking for an experienced Service Advisor with a strong automotive background and excellent customer service skills.
The successful Service Advisor will ideally have:
Previous experience as a Service Advisor within an automotive dealership
Minimum 2 years' dealership experience
Experience within an aftersales, workshop or service environment
Strong knowledge of vehicle servicing and repairs
Strong organisational skills and the ability to multitask
Ability to manage multiple customer requirements in a busy workshop environment
Confident using computerised dealership systems
Good commercial awareness and the ability to identify additional sales opportunities
Ability to work effectively as part of a busy team
Full UK driving licence desirable
Right to work in the UK

APPLY TODAY
If you're an experienced Service Advisor, Automotive Service Advisor, Aftersales Advisor, Service Receptionist or Dealership Service Advisor looking for a new opportunity in Crewe, offering a £34,500 OTE, regular working hours, manufacturer training and career development, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Credit Controller
description:
CREDIT CONTROLLER
MACCLESFIELD, CHESHIRE
UP TO £29,200 + EXCELLENT BENEFITS

THE OPPORTUNITY:
We're partnering with a well-established and growing business in Macclesfield that is looking to recruit an experienced Credit Controller to join its successful finance team.
The successful Credit Controller will take ownership of an extensive customer ledger, focusing on maximising cash collection, reducing outstanding debt and managing customer relationships.
You'll be joining an established team within a fast-paced business that boasts an impressive portfolio of clients, where you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact on cash flow and financial performance.

- Managing an extensive customer ledger, ensuring outstanding debts are collected efficiently and within agreed payment terms

- Handling challenging conversations with customers professionally and confidently to secure payment commitments

- Liaising with internal departments to resolve disputes and ensure outstanding balances are collected
- Supporting the wider credit control team with debt reduction initiatives and improvements to collection processes

- Proven experience managing customer ledgers and proactively chasing outstanding payments
- Confident making high volumes of outbound calls and handling difficult conversations with customers
- Strong understanding of credit control processes, cash collection and debt reduction
- Previous experience with computerised accounting software is beneficial
- Results-driven with experience working towards KPIs, targets and strict deadlines
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills with the ability to build rapport quickly
- Strong IT skills, numeracy and attention to detail
- Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively under pressure

You will be capable of developing good administritive and organisational skills and have experience of using computers. Experience of working in healthcare is not essential as long as you possess the above qualities and are willing and eager to learn new skills and are flexible in your approach to work. We will provide in house training and continuing support.

title: Receptionist
description: At Earnswood Medical Practice, we are committed to providing friendly, caring and professional support to our patients. We are looking for a welcoming and organised receptionist to join our busy team. As a first point of contact, you will help patients access the care they need, treating everyone with kindness, patience and respect. If you enjoy helping people and working as part of a team, we would love to hear from you. The following are the core responsibilities of the Receptionist. There may be, on occasion, a requirement to carry out other tasks. This will be dependent upon factors such as workload and staffing levels: Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system under the direction of the Operations Manager or Reception Supervisor. Process face to face, telephone and e-requests for appointments, dealing with daily administrative tasks regarding patient care. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately. Primary responsibilities Process appointment requests received in person, by telephone and electronically, following practice procedures. Answer incoming telephone calls courteously and professionally, responding to enquiries or directing callers to the appropriate colleague or service. Welcome patients and visitors, assist with enquiries and help patients access the care and support they need. Book, amend and cancel appointments accurately, including appointments requested following clinical triage. Support patients to use online services and appointment systems, offering assistance where needed. Process repeat prescription requests in line with practice procedures, referring medication queries to the appropriate clinician. Record and update patient information accurately, maintaining confidentiality at all times. Receive, record and pass on messages, correspondence and patient requests promptly to the appropriate team. Complete daily administrative tasks relating to patient care, including registrations, document handling and electronic tasks as required. Communicate sensitively with patients and carers, recognising individual needs and treating everyone with dignity and respect. Recognise urgent concerns and promptly alert the appropriate clinician, following practice protocols. Raise complaints, concerns and incidents with the appropriate manager and follow practice reporting procedures. Work flexibly with colleagues to support reception cover and the smooth running of the practice.

title: Medical Receptionist

The position will be 4 full days with various working hours of 08.00-17.00 and 08.00-18.30.
